description: This source file defines a React hook called useTheme that manages theme settings within a web application. It interacts with application state via custom hooks, updates the DOM for theme persistence, and provides methods to toggle and set themes.

methods.name: useTheme()
methods.description: Custom React hook that returns the current theme and functions to toggle or set it. It also synchronizes the theme with the document's data-theme attribute.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Function to set the application's theme by dispatching the setTheme action.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to toggle the application's theme by dispatching the toggleTheme action.
